tickets.title: Prepare home-care funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side funding projection for Lena and Arun Cloudpuddle using weekday home-care aide invoices ($3,400/month), disability income, pension, Social Security, and portfolio balances to compare continued care, expanded evening coverage, and a limited assisted-living trial.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to prepare that projection for 2024-06-07.

tickets.title: Coordinate long-term care claim packet
tickets.text: Coordinate the financial portion of Lena Cloudpuddle’s long-term care claim with Buttonwood Balloon Life insurer and Pocket Lantern Home Care agency, assembling care invoices, physician certification, and ADL statement for review.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is that coordination for 2024-06-03.

tickets.title: Obtain Pocket Lantern care records
tickets.text: Obtain from Pocket Lantern Home Care the signed care plan, weekly caregiver schedule, and rate sheet showing weekday versus weekend charges to separate recurring care costs from one-time setup fees for the Cloudpuddle planning file.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to obtain those records for 2024-06-10.

tickets.title: Resolve long-term care benefit mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the discrepancy between the insurer portal’s $180 daily benefit and the policy declaration’s $210 daily benefit for Lena Cloudpuddle’s long-term care policy to ensure accurate claim modeling.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to resolve the mismatch for 2024-06-04.

tickets.title: Address care invoice delivery issue
tickets.text: Address the invoice delivery problem by arranging for Pocket Lantern Home Care to send invoices to a shared email address rather than Lena Cloudpuddle’s personal email, improving reimbursement tracking for Arun and Priya.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to address invoice delivery for 2024-05-31.

tickets.title: Develop backup caregiver schedule and cost
tickets.text: Develop a temporary caregiver coverage schedule and estimate a short-term cost range for the period of Arun Cloudpuddle’s knee rehabilitation, ensuring continuity of assistance for Lena during his recovery.
tickets.evidence: The committed follow-up is to develop that schedule and cost range for 2024-06-12.
